disputes.intro: Kukazyanya kwabweendelezi nkowakabusya kuli basikuula kwalo kwakakilwa kuti nzintu zyobile. Mweendelezi Leadrat ulalanga-langa chimwi achimwi.
disputes.empty: Tokwe nowakabusya mazwanga aali woonse. Kuti kasitoma ngowakaleta wakakilwa kuba nduwe, ulakonzya kukazya kuzwa kukulembesya.
disputes.withdrawConfirm: Kogwisya kukazyania kwako kwa {{name}} ? Bweendelezi buliwo lino buli mbuli mbububede.
disputes.raiseHint: Kuti kasitoma ooyu wakasaanguna kuboola kuli nduwe, kopandulula kaambo. Mweendelezi Leadrat ulalanga-langa; kuti basala munzila iigwasya, musololi ulalembedwe kuli nduwe.
disputes.notProtected: Taakwe uukwabilila kasitoma ooyu mumulimo ooyu limbi - ulakonzya kulilembya sikusololela lino.
